narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The mean has to be one of the counts, so I pick the middle one, seven.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The mean is not picked from the list, it comes from evening the days out.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>The number we reach may not be any day's count at all.

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>The mean is the equal level the values reach when we even them out.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>No day had five flowers, and that is fine for a mean.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Your turn. Another plant has one, six, eight, three and two flowers. Find the mean.
